- [x] I agree to license this contribution under the terms of [LICENSE.txt](https://github.com/NVIDIA/cudnn-frontend/blob/develop/LICENSE.txt).
- [x] I ran `pre-commit run` and committed any formatting changes.
- [x] I reviewed the Hard Rules in the `AGENTS.md` for each directory this PR touches (see [root AGENTS.md § Reviewing a PR](https://github.com/NVIDIA/cudnn-frontend/blob/develop/AGENTS.md#reviewing-a-pr-human-or-agent)) and my changes comply, or I explain the exception below.
- [ ] I added GitHub labels: one `cat-*`, one or more `area:*` / `op:*`, and one `orig-*` (see [label list](https://github.com/NVIDIA/cudnn-frontend/labels)). I cannot set labels on this repository; suggested: `orig-external`, `cat-enhancements`, `area:global_attention`.

## Affected area

FE OSS kernels or CuTeDSL

## Summary

- Admit cc 10.3 on the d128 backward (`sdpa_bwd_sm100_d128`) paths that were gated to exact cc 10.0: the dense MHA accumulation chain, packed THD MHA and grouped GQA/MQA (dense and THD). One `ACCUMULATION_CCS = ((10, 0), (10, 3))` tuple in `d128_contract.py` is used by plan-time implementation selection, the engine's declaration check and both prepared entries.
- Compile the THD and grouped prepared hosts for the build device's arch. They passed a fixed `100` (`--gpu-arch sm_100a`) while the dense hosts already pass `cc[0] * 10 + cc[1]`; on SM103 the fixed target left no positional tvm-ffi entry, and every THD / grouped case failed with "requires a positional tvm-ffi entry".
- Eligibility tests: cc 10.3 is now admitted; the decline cases use an in-envelope cc that is neither 10.0 nor 10.3. The API page and `SUPPORT_MATRIX_TRACKER.md` (Rule S2, same commit) state cc 10.0 or 10.3 and record the B300 run below.

## Why

On B300 (cc 10.3) dense d128 MHA backward fell back to the one-launch recompute implementation, and THD and grouped d128 declarations were declined, although the same CuTeDSL kernels build for `sm_103a` and pass the existing suites unchanged. The tracker said "the new chain is not selected on SM103" and "SM103 d128 remains unsupported for THD". This also fills the d128 backward cells of the SM103 support-matrix issue.

## Related issues

Related to #380.

## API and compatibility impact

No API change. On cc 10.3 the opt-in d128 backward engine now selects the accumulation chain for dense MHA that meets its existing conditions (it previously used the recompute implementation there) and accepts THD and grouped declarations it previously declined. cc 10.0 behaviour and every other cc are unchanged. Capability only: no B300 performance claim; the row stays opt-in.

## Testing

One B300 (cc 10.3), develop `4e27a6fa`, `pip install -e .` (FE 1.32.0), cuDNN 9.27.0, CuTeDSL 4.8.1, torch 2.14.1+cu130, each file run from `test/python/sdpa/frost` with `python -m pytest <file> -q`:

| File | develop | this PR |
|---|---|---|
| `test_sdpa_bwd_d128_sm100.py` | 35 passed | 35 passed |
| `test_sdpa_bwd_d128_accum_sm100.py` | 3 passed, 12 skipped | 15 passed |
| `test_sdpa_bwd_d128_thd_sm100.py` | 24 skipped | 24 passed |
| `test_sdpa_bwd_d128_grouped_sm100.py` | 1 passed, 22 skipped | 23 passed |
| `test_sdpa_bwd_d128_thd_eligibility.py` | 36 passed | 37 passed |
| `test_sdpa_bwd_d128_grouped_eligibility.py` | 47 passed | 48 passed |
| `test_sdpa_bwd_d128_dense_bounds.py` | 26 passed | 26 passed |
| `test_sdpa_bwd_d128_stats_span.py` | 6 passed | 6 passed |

Total 214/214 on cc 10.3. With only the admission change (fixed `sm_100a` hosts) the THD and grouped files failed 24/24 and 22/23, which is how the compile-target issue was found. Not run here: an SM100 regression pass (cc 10.0 paths are unchanged apart from the shared tuple and the arch argument, which is `100` there as before), and any performance measurement. After the run, `black` reformatted one parametrize line in `test_sdpa_bwd_d128_thd_eligibility.py`; no other change.


### Review follow-up (2026-10-22)

`4b250ee5b89e` updates the sibling heuristic test's grouped BF16 expectation to include cc 10.3 alongside cc 10.0. The same parametrization still rejects grouped cc 10.6 and grouped HALF; production eligibility is unchanged by this follow-up.

Validation for the follow-up: changed-file pre-commit hooks and `git diff --check` passed. The three-case heuristic pytest and GPU suites have not been rerun for this commit. The 214-test B300 table above and pipeline 75852379 refer to the original head `0e4f6afba227`; the pipeline's stale expectation was the reason for this test-only update. They are retained as historical evidence, not a fresh GPU result.

### Documentation follow-up (2026-10-22)

`eb135e8293d3` resolves the remaining P3 support-summary note: the d128 engine docstring, both support-matrix summaries, and the API overview entry now name SM100 and SM103 for the already-admitted THD/grouped paths. CuTeDSL >= 4.8, positive FP32 scale, dtype and layout restrictions are retained.

Validation: changed-file pre-commit and `git diff --check` passed. Python compilation passed and the full `engines.py` AST, with docstrings removed, is identical to `4b250ee5b89e`; this follow-up changes no executable code. The [independent review of `4b250ee5b89e`](https://github.com/NVIDIA/cudnn-frontend/pull/1783#pullrequestreview-5616998163) reports **44/44** heuristic-file tests passing, including the rejection cases. Those are mocked-capability host declaration tests, not native execution on every named architecture. No new GPU result is claimed; updated integration checks remain pending.

## Affected area

FE OSS kernels or CuTeDSL

## Summary

- Admit cc 10.3 on the d128 backward (`sdpa_bwd_sm100_d128`) paths that were gated to exact cc 10.0: the dense MHA accumulation chain, packed THD MHA and grouped GQA/MQA (dense and THD). One `ACCUMULATION_CCS = ((10, 0), (10, 3))` tuple in `d128_contract.py` is used by plan-time implementation selection, the engine's declaration check and both prepared entries.
- Compile the THD and grouped prepared hosts for the build device's arch. They passed a fixed `100` (`--gpu-arch sm_100a`) while the dense hosts already pass `cc[0] * 10 + cc[1]`; on SM103 the fixed target left no positional tvm-ffi entry, and every THD / grouped case failed with "requires a positional tvm-ffi entry".
- Eligibility tests: cc 10.3 is now admitted; the decline cases use an in-envelope cc that is neither 10.0 nor 10.3. The API page and `SUPPORT_MATRIX_TRACKER.md` (Rule S2, same commit) state cc 10.0 or 10.3 and record the B300 run below.

## Why

On B300 (cc 10.3) dense d128 MHA backward fell back to the one-launch recompute implementation, and THD and grouped d128 declarations were declined, although the same CuTeDSL kernels build for `sm_103a` and pass the existing suites unchanged. The tracker said "the new chain is not selected on SM103" and "SM103 d128 remains unsupported for THD". This also fills the d128 backward cells of the SM103 support-matrix issue.

## Related issues

Related to #380.

## API and compatibility impact

No API change. On cc 10.3 the opt-in d128 backward engine now selects the accumulation chain for dense MHA that meets its existing conditions (it previously used the recompute implementation there) and accepts THD and grouped declarations it previously declined. cc 10.0 behaviour and every other cc are unchanged. Capability only: no B300 performance claim; the row stays opt-in.

One B300 (cc 10.3), develop `4e27a6fa`, `pip install -e .` (FE 1.32.0), cuDNN 9.27.0, CuTeDSL 4.8.1, torch 2.14.1+cu130, each file run from `test/python/sdpa/frost` with `python -m pytest <file> -q`:
